sn54.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn54.9:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn54.9:2.3: namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenāti.
sn54.9:2.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā nāssudha koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamati aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena.
sn54.9:3.2: bhagavā anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti anekākāravokāraṃ asubhabhāvanānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti
sn54.9:3.3: te iminā kāyena aṭṭiyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakaṃ pariyesanti
sn54.9:3.4: dasapi bhikkhū ekāhena satthaṃ āharanti vīsatipi …pe… tiṃsatipi bhikkhū ekāhena satthaṃ āharanti.
sn54.9:4.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa addhamāsassa accayena paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
sn54.9:4.2: kinnu kho ānanda tanubhūto viya bhikkhusaṅghoti.
sn54.9:4.3: tathā hi pana bhante bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. te bhante bhikkhū bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena asubhakathaṃ katheti asubhāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati asubhabhāvanāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti anekākāravokāraṃ asubhabhāvanānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti
sn54.9:4.4: te iminā kāyena aṭṭiyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakaṃ pariyesanti
sn54.9:4.5: dasapi bhikkhū ekāhena satthaṃ āharanti vīsatipi …pe… tiṃsatipi bhikkhū ekāhena satthaṃ āharanti.
sn54.9:4.6: sādhu bhante bhagavā pariyāyaṃ ācikkhatu yathāyaṃ bhikkhusaṅgho aññāya saṇṭhaheyyāti.
sn54.9:5.1: tenahānanda yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehīti.
sn54.9:5.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn54.9:6.1: atha kho bhagavā yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn54.9:6.3: ayaṃpi kho bhikkhave ānāpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo ceva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
sn54.9:7.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ūhataṃ rajojallaṃ tamenaṃ mahā akālamegho ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
sn54.9:7.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ānāpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo ceva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
sn54.9:7.3: kathaṃ bhāvito ca bhikkhave ānāpānassatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato santo ceva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
sn54.9:8.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
sn54.9:8.3: paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.9:8.4: evaṃ bhāvito kho bhikkhave ānāpānassatisamādhi evaṃ bahulīkato santo ceva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppannuppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasametīti.
